rationale: All three required hashes verify. The target faithfully inlines Z_N=(S_N-N/2)/sqrt(N/4) and states the exact event identity underlying the first equality of Equation (2.2). Positive N makes sqrt(N/4) strictly positive, so the standardized inequality is pointwise equivalent to S_N≥3N/4. The inherited independent fair-toss model, uncentered head count, center N/2, normalization sqrt(N/4), and threshold are all preserved exactly. Both implication directions hold, and the event-level formulation is a harmless definitional strengthening with no independent mathematical content.
